verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly cover calling external APIs and custom functions during a conversation. Options include webhook tools for third-party calls and authenticated actions, client-side tools, sandboxed custom JavaScript on ElevenLabs' infrastructure, and connections to external MCP servers. The 'without awkward dead air' part rests only on generic 'ultra-low latency' marketing, not on any documented tool-latency handling. Missing for 10: documented filler or pre-tool speech and async handling to mask tool-call latency, how tool results are spoken back, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
